finalText:
All objectives verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE:** Ticket `fwrd50-n1 RD Bench Ticket` exists, reference **RD-1015** (detail URL `http://127.0.0.1:4180/#/tickets/t15`), created 2026-09-13, initial status Draft.

**Objective 2 — DONE:** Part `fwrd50-n1 RD Part A` added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$125.00** (ticket total $125.00).

**Objective 3 — DONE:** Part `fwrd50-n1 RD Part B` added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$250.00** (ticket total rose to $375.00).

**Objective 4 — DONE:** Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup unchanged at 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (ticket total rose to $437.50; Part B unchanged at $250.00).

**Objective 5 — DONE:** Ticket ends in status **Ready**. Precondition discovered: clicking "Mark Ready" was initially refused with the verbatim message:
> "Ticket is not ready — Part "fwrd50-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier / Part "fwrd50-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"

What was required: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier**. I edited each part and filled the previously-blank Supplier field with "Acme Supplies" (cost, markup, quantity unchanged), then "Mark Ready" succeeded with no error. Status chip changed to "Ready" and the action buttons became "Mark Draft"/"Mark Closed".

**Objective 6 — DONE:** Both parts deleted (each via the row's Delete action → in-page Confirm dialog → "Delete part" button); the parts table then showed "No parts on this ticket yet." Archiving was accepted with no validation error or precondition — confirmation was the new red **"Archived"** badge next to the "Ready" status chip and the action button changing to "Unarchive ticket". Verified on the ticket list: RD-1015 is absent from the active list (13 active tickets shown, newest RD-1014) and appears only when "Show archived" is ticked, with 0 parts. Nothing created by this run remains active.
